why: RE-VERDICTED phase-417 W4.f. was `gap` over the WHOLE parameter surface; `nros::LifecycleNode` now carries it, forwarding every call to the `rclcpp::Node` that `bind(Node&)` supplied, so the store, the per-node keying and the declared-parameter contract are reached through one implementation and a lifecycle node's parameters are visible to `ros2 param get` exactly as a plain node's are. A table on the wrapper would have been the second store phase-426 spent six work items removing, in a smaller spelling. What the glob covers NOW is the four rows whose `cpp:Node::` twins are also `declined` -- `get_parameters`, `set_parameters`, `describe_parameters` and `get_node_parameters_interface`, all of which take or return a `std::vector` of a generated message type or an interface handle we do not have. Every other row has its own entry, because the reasons now differ; see the `cpp:Node::*` twin of each.
